body.segment: Shape-memory surfaces with on-demand, tunable nanopatterns are developed to observe time dependent changes in cell alignment using temperature-responsive poly(?-caprolactone) (PCL) films.
Temporary grooved nanopatterns are easily programmed on the films and triggered to transition quickly to permanent surface patterns by the application of body heat.
A time-dependent cytoskeleton remodeling is also observed under biologically relevant conditions.
